overview: This Senate resolution designates April 5, 2025, as "Gold Star Wives Day." Gold Star Wives of America is an organization, founded in 1945, that supports the surviving spouses and children of service members and veterans who died on active duty or from service-related disabilities. The date marks the 80th anniversary of the group's first meeting. The resolution honors the group's members and encourages Americans to learn about its work supporting military survivors. It does not create programs or provide money. The Senate approved it by unanimous consent on April 10, 2025.
for: Supporters say the resolution honors the families of fallen service members and the group that has supported them for 80 years.
against: Critics say the resolution is symbolic and does not change any law or benefits for military survivors.
